reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was the QR code and 'Every batch lab-tested' on the box, and a named ISO 17025 lab is more than most brands give me. I would try one box for sleep, but only after opening the batch report, and it is 2 capsules per sachet, so I would check that the 200 mg is really per serving.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal, so the lab report is only the brand's own claim until I read it. At about $1 a day it is not cheap for something nobody has vouched for.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, or a real batch report that opens and shows the magnesium content matching the label.
